title: SS27 Kids' Formalwear Styling
summary: Occasion and formal SS27 kidswear: sailor collars, crisp cotton, pleated dresses and "princess" luxury dressing for ceremonies and summer events.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Speranza and Junona represent luxury "princess" style at Pitti Bimbo<sup>[1]</sup>; pleated dresses appear among SS27 silhouettes<sup>[2]</sup>; sailor collars and navy recur at Playtime Paris<sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Formulas
sections.body:
- **Sailor-collar shirt + navy shorts + loafers** (boys' ceremony look).
- **Pleated or smocked dress + cardigan + ballerinas.**
- **Linen shirt + tailored shorts** for summer weddings.
- **Voile dress with embroidery.**

design_implications:
- Lined, soft-touch occasion pieces; avoid scratchy seams and stiff tulle against skin.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Occasionwear sells around communions, weddings and holidays; time deliveries for spring.
